## User problem

What user-visible problem does this change solve?

## Change

Summarize the implementation and important tradeoffs.

## Verification

List the exact checks run and their results. Attach evidence for UI, boot,
installation, hardware, or release claims.

## Risk and rollback

What could regress, and how can the change be safely reversed?

## Checklist

- [ ] I kept this pull request focused on one logical change.
- [ ] I removed credentials, private data, generated build artifacts, and unrelated files.
- [ ] I preserved applicable copyright and license notices.
- [ ] I updated documentation or translations when user-visible behavior changed.
- [ ] I did not present virtualized testing as proof of physical-hardware compatibility.
- [ ] I ran the relevant checks from `CONTRIBUTING.md`.
